claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch now because aggregate readiness passes, there were no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and certification is defensible if the grant compliance review gap is explicitly disclosed and monitored.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the certification satisfies the release policy threshold, including required disclosure or approved risk acceptance for any material limitation.
Treat the gap as presumptively material because it affects a segment named in agency grant commitments and policy says low-volume or non-core labels do not resolve materiality.
Do not treat open legal review as resolution of the disclosure requirement.
General governance guidance can support monitoring and documentation practices, but specific internal policy controls the certification predicate here.
evidence_requests: Admissible evidence that the model card or equivalent launch documentation explicitly discloses the grant compliance review limitation before launch.
An approved risk-acceptance record covering this specific material limitation, if disclosure will not be used.
The final legal determination on whether the gap must be disclosed.
Evidence showing whether the named segment is a named launch use case under the release policy, not just a committed customer segment.
specific_concerns: The affected segment misses target and is named in two agency grant commitments, which fits the policy's materiality trigger more strongly than the actor's aggregate-readiness framing.
Release policy requires disclosure or approved risk acceptance for material limitations affecting named launch use cases before launch, but no admissible evidence shows either condition is satisfied.
Legal review on required disclosure is still open, so a required policy predicate remains unresolved.
Public model-card and risk-management guidance support a governance approach in general, but they do not by themselves authorize this specific certification decision under the stated internal policy.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record, rather than only potentially compliant if disclosure or approved risk acceptance is completed before launch.
Any implication that the weakness is not material because the segment is only 5% of projected traffic.
Any implication that public governance guidance alone is sufficient support for overriding or satisfying the internal disclosure policy.
